hero.label: Franciacorta · Ome · Brescia
hero.quote: Come discover Franciacorta, stay with us, and let yourself be charmed

intro.title: In the heart of the
intro.para1: San Michele welcomes its guests among the vineyards of Ome. A family-run establishment where the warmth of authentic hospitality blends with a constant focus on quality: local cuisine, rooms with panoramic views, and the magic of the surrounding landscape.
intro.para2: Located in the hilly part of Franciacorta, just a short walk from the best wineries, this is the perfect place for anyone who wants to get a taste of our region

cards.title: The Hotel
cards.desc: 16 rooms with views of the Franciacorta vineyards. Breakfast, swimming pool, panoramic terrace.

cards.title: The Restaurant
cards.desc: Signature Lombard cuisine, local seasonal ingredients, and a Franciacorta DOCG wine list.

cards.title: Franciacorta
cards.desc: Vineyards, abbeys, Lake Iseo, and Brescia. Franciacorta is waiting to be explored.

cards.title: The Clinic
cards.desc: The San Rocco Clinical Institute in Ome — a center of medical excellence just a short walk from the Hotel San Michele.

menuTeaser.title: The Menu
menuTeaser.para1: The hotel's kitchen emphasizes seasonal ingredients and favors local suppliers, fresh pasta, meat, game, and fish from our lake.
menuTeaser.para2: All allergens are clearly listed on each dish in accordance with EU Regulation 1169/2011. The menu also includes a selection of Franciacorta wines.

bookCta.title: Book your
bookCta.body: Contact us directly for the best available rates. Our team will respond as soon as possible.
